    Pre-Treatment Balance Diagnostics Table for multiout_synth Objects

    balance_table.Rd

    Computes and formats a pre-treatment balance table comparing the treated group, the synthetic control, and the unweighted donor pool for each outcome.

    balance_table(
  fit,
  Y_list,
  treat_time,
  L,
  outcomes = NULL,
  standardize_outcomes = FALSE,
  intercept = c("none", "outcome", "global"),
  time_weights = NULL,
  eps_sd = 1e-08,
  std_denom = c("treated", "pooled", "donor"),
  show_sd = FALSE,
  show_donors_mean = TRUE,
  digits = 3L,
  format = c("console", "latex", "markdown", "none"),
  caption = NULL,
  label = "tab:balance",
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    fit

    List returned by multiout_synth().

    Y_list

    Named list of \(T \times N\) outcome matrices. Names become the row labels in the table.

    treat_time

    Numeric vector length \(N\); first treated row index per unit (Inf = never treated). Same vector passed to multiout_synth.

    L

    Integer; number of pre-treatment lags balanced. Same value passed to multiout_synth.

    outcomes

    Character vector of outcome names to include. Defaults to names(Y_list).

    standardize_outcomes

    Logical. If TRUE, RMSE and SMD are computed on the standardised scale used by build_Xy_for_unit. Means are always in raw units. Default FALSE.

    intercept

    Character matching the intercept argument passed to multiout_synth. Controls whether the pre-treatment mean is removed from gaps before computing RMSE:

    "none"

    No demeaning (default).

    "outcome"

    Remove the time-weighted pre-treatment mean per outcome per treated unit before computing gaps, matching demean_within_outcome_blocks. Means and SMDs are unaffected.

    "global"

    Remove a single time-weighted grand mean per treated unit across all outcomes.

    time_weights

    Optional numeric vector length L. Must match the time_weights passed to multiout_synth. Default NULL (uniform).

    eps_sd

    Small positive floor for SD when standardising.

    std_denom

    Denominator for standardised mean differences: "treated" (SD across treated-unit pre-treatment means, default), "pooled" (pooled treated + donor SD), or "donor".

    show_sd

    Logical. Add an SD (Treated) column. Default FALSE.

    show_donors_mean

    Logical. Include unweighted donor mean and SMD vs donors. Default TRUE.

    digits

    Integer. Decimal places in formatted output. Default 3.

    format

    One of "console" (default), "latex", "markdown", "none".

    caption

    Caption string for latex/markdown tables.

    label

    LaTeX label. Default "tab:balance".

    verbose

    Logical. Print header with sample counts and L. Default TRUE.

    Value

    A data.frame (invisibly) with columns Outcome, Mean_Treated, Mean_Synthetic, and RMSE. When show_sd = TRUE, SD_Treated is added. When show_donors_mean = TRUE, Mean_Donors and SMD_Donors are added. SMD_Synthetic is always present.

    Why raw inputs are required

    multiout_synth does not store Y_list, treat_time, or L inside the returned object, so they must be passed explicitly here using the same values supplied to multiout_synth.

    Matrix orientation

    Y_list matrices must be \(N \times T\) (unit rows, time-period columns), as produced by panel_to_Ylist_int_time (2633 units × 156 periods in your case). treat_time is length \(N\), with values being 1-based column indices of the first treated period.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tab <- balance_table(
  fit        = fit,
  Y_list     = Y_list,
  treat_time = treat_time,
  L          = L
)

# LaTeX for a paper
balance_table(fit, Y_list, treat_time, L,
              format  = "latex",
              caption = "Pre-treatment balance",
              label   = "tab:balance")

# Love plot of SMDs (missing loveplot?)
tab <- balance_table(fit, Y_list, treat_time, L, show_donors_mean = TRUE)
} # }
